input.command: cd /workspace && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -50 && echo '---' && cat dotenv/*.py 2>/dev/null | head -100
cd /workspace && ls -la tests dotenv .yecoding && echo '---tests---' && for f in tests/*.py; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace && cat -n dotenv/variables.py && echo '---parser---' && cat -n dotenv/parser.py
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -40
